description.zh: 数据时间字符串，格式为HH:mm:ss
description.en: The data timestamp of the job. Specify a string in the HH:mm:ss format.

description.zh: 结束日期时间戳，精确到毫秒
description.en: The time when the job stops running. Specify a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

description.zh: 应用分组ID，在控制台的应用管理页面中获取
description.en: The application group ID. You can obtain the application group ID on the Application Management page in the SchedulerX console.

description.zh: 命名空间ID，在控制台的命名空间页面中获取
description.en: The namespace ID. You can obtain the namespace ID on the Namespace page in the SchedulerX console.

description.zh: 特殊第三方才需要填写
description.en: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for a special third party.

description.zh: 开始日期时间戳，精确到毫秒
description.en: The time when the job starts to rerun. Specify a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 rerun-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --namespace-source schedulerx --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --job-id 123 --start-date 1645459200000 --end-date 1645718400000 --data-time 10:00:00 --region cn-hangzhou
